info.name: Library Management System
info.description:
API collection for the Library Management System.

**Setup:**
- `base_url` (default: `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`)
- `access_token` is auto-set after a successful Register / Login
- `author_id` and `book_id` are auto-set after their Create requests

**Authentication:**
The collection has `Bearer {{access_token}}` set at the collection level. Every request inherits it automatically. Public requests (register / login / health) and negative auth tests use `noauth` explicitly.
